most_valuable_insight.title: The Self-Service Automation Pattern
most_valuable_insight.description: Cloudflare transforms manual bottleneck processes (weeks) into instant API calls (minutes) using cryptographic/algorithmic verification. Pattern: (1) Identify human bottleneck, (2) Add verification mechanism, (3) Expose via self-service API, (4) Measure time reduction.
most_valuable_insight.generic_formula: Automation without verification = chaos. Verification without automation = bottlenecks. Combine both for self-service excellence.
chained_applications: Agent onboarding: Manual review → automated scoring
Mission assignment: Manual selection → relevance algorithms
Performance evaluation: Manual assessment → automated metrics
most_valuable_insight.transferability: Appears across multiple Cloudflare innovations (BYOIP, serverless-dns, Workers), making it the most actionable insight
